title.ko: although · even though · despite · in spite of · whereas · however
title.en: although · even though · despite · in spite of · whereas · however

explain.ko: 대조와 양보는 예상과 다른 상황이나 두 대상의 차이를 나타냅니다. although, even though, though는 절을 이끕니다(Although he is rich, he isn't happy). despite와 in spite of는 뒤에 명사나 -ing가 옵니다(Despite the rain). 절이 이어지면 despite the fact that을 씁니다. whereas와 while은 두 대상을 대조하며 쉼표와 함께 씁니다. however, nevertheless, even so, on the other hand는 문장을 연결하는 부사로 앞에 마침표나 세미콜론이 오고 뒤에 쉼표가 옵니다. but과 although는 한 문장에 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
explain.en: Contrast and concession show unexpected situations or differences. Although, even though and though introduce a clause (Although he is rich, he isn't happy). Despite and in spite of take a noun or -ing (Despite the rain). Before a clause use despite the fact that. Whereas and while contrast two things, with a comma. However, nevertheless, even so and on the other hand are linking adverbs, used after a full stop or semicolon and followed by a comma. Don't use but and although in the same sentence.

head: 연결어 / Linker
뒤에 오는 것 / Followed by
예문 / Example
rows: He is tall, whereas she is short.

notes.ko: although 절과 but 절을 한 문장에 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Don't use although and but together in one sentence.

notes.ko: despite 뒤에는 of를 쓰지 않습니다. in spite of만 of가 있습니다.
notes.en: Despite has no of; in spite of does.

notes.ko: however 앞에는 마침표나 세미콜론을, 뒤에는 쉼표를 씁니다.
notes.en: Put a full stop or semicolon before however and a comma after it.

prompt.ko: although, despite, whereas, however를 모두 써서 장단점을 말하는 4문장을 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences giving pros and cons, using although, despite, whereas and however.

task.model: Although the city is convenient, it is very noisy. Despite high housing prices, many people want to live in the city. The city has many jobs, whereas the countryside has clean air. However, I still prefer city life.

model_trans.en: Although the city is convenient, it is very noisy. Despite high housing prices, many people want to live in the city. The city has many jobs, whereas the countryside has clean air. However, I still prefer city life.
